notes.title: Gameplay optimization
notes.notes:
We have made a number of improvements, added visibility to objects, and improved mouse performance. We carefully read your feedback and improve the game constantly! I hope you enjoy the game.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjzcb4R/mouse.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Improved visibility of objects
notes.notes:

notes.title: Interactive mouse
notes.notes: We have read your wishes and are releasing an update. Now the mouse will tell you where the interactive object is located. I hope you will enjoy!
